name: thismoon
description: Claude Code mods from the thismoon platform repo: bands, status lines, and hooks that sit beside the *.this services and skills.

plugins.name: session-band
plugins.description: A band above the prompt: agent state, the active worklog key, the work-on phase, the present page, and belt denies this session.

plugins.name: humanizer-gate
plugins.description: Runs humanizer detection on prose as it leaves the session: a status line on markdown writes, a hold dialog on PR bodies and commit messages with error-level findings.

plugins.name: panel-policy
plugins.description: Runs review and verifier subagents on the review model, counts the agents a turn spawns, and keeps a panel progress band above the prompt.

plugins.name: loom-pane
plugins.description: A status line naming the session's loom role, plus guards that keep an owner inside its own worktree and ask before a removal loses work.
